overview: The Council approved a $3 million appropriation for the Medford High School feasibility study and established several new stabilization funds to manage the city's free cash reserves. The meeting also featured significant debate regarding a proposed moratorium on methadone clinics following the withdrawal of a controversial permit application in the Salem Street corridor.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions and Retirement Resolutions
items.summary: The Council approved resolutions celebrating Tom Lincoln’s service to the Brooks Estate and honoring the retirements of Assistant City Clerk Sylvia de Placido, Principal Clerk Janice DePace, and teacher Donna Lasky.

items.title: Condolences and Minutes Approval
items.summary: The Council sent condolences to the family of the late Police Detective Lauren Kane and approved the records from the June 11, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Committee Reports and Medford Square MassDOT Intersection
items.summary: The Council approved a Planning and Permitting Committee report and referred a resolution regarding MassDOT's planned changes to a Medford Square intersection to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: Moratorium on Methadone Clinic Licenses (Order 24-426)
items.summary: Following the withdrawal of a special permit application for a treatment center at 360 Salem Street, the Council referred a proposed moratorium to the Planning and Permitting Committee to develop zoning amendments for medical distribution facilities.

items.title: Civic Board and Committee Appointments
items.summary: The Council confirmed six appointments to the Medford Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board, along with appointments to the Community Preservation Committee, the License Commission, and the Medford Housing Authority.

items.title: Special Permits: Great American Beer Hall and Raising Cane’s
items.summary: Approved a special permit for extended hours for Great American Beer Hall with mandatory reviews and approved a conditional common victualler license for Raising Cane’s.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee FY2025 Budget and Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved the $2.06 million annual CPC budget and a $30,000 appropriation for school-based projects, including bicycle repair stations and recreational equipment.

items.title: Creation of the South Street Historic District (Ordinance 24-421)
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of an ordinance establishing a local historic district for South Street to preserve pre-Civil War homes associated with the city's shipbuilding history.

items.title: Medford High School Feasibility Study Appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $3 million from free cash to fund a mandatory MSBA feasibility study for a new or renovated Medford High School.

items.title: Establishment of Municipal Stabilization Funds
items.summary: The Council established and funded General, Capital, and Water and Sewer Capital Stabilization funds using $13 million from free cash and retained earnings to align with state financial best practices.

items.title: Shared Services Statute and Non-Union Wage Adjustments
items.summary: The Council accepted a state statute allowing for shared services between city and school departments and approved salary adjustments for non-union personnel, the HR Director, and the City Solicitor.
